ValidationRule.description: Proposal Created Date cannot be in the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((RecordType_Name__c = "Retention RM") || (RecordType_Name__c = "Retention SH")) && NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Proposal_Created_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Proposal_Created_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Proposal_Created_Date__c) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Proposal_Created_Date__c)) || DATEVALUE(Proposal_Created_Date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Proposal_Created_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Proposal Created Date cannot be in the Future.
